# 1.1.1.1
> One of the Internet’s fastest, privacy-first DNS resolvers for faster, more secure web browsing.

Cloudflare’s 1.1.1.1 service provides public DNS resolution focused on speed, privacy, and simple setup for individuals and families. The site includes product overviews, family-safe filtering options, and localized DNS setup pages.

## Core Pages
- [1.1.1.1 Home](https://cloudflare-dns.com/): Main landing page for Cloudflare’s privacy-first DNS resolver.
- [DNS](https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns/): Overview of public DNS resolver features and benefits.
- [Families](https://cloudflare-dns.com/family/): Family-safe DNS options with malware and adult content filtering.

## DNS Service
- [DNS Overview](https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns/): Explains Cloudflare DNS performance, privacy, and resolver basics.
- [1.1.1.1 Home](https://cloudflare-dns.com/): Entry point for browsing a faster, more private internet.
- [Families](https://cloudflare-dns.com/family/): DNS filtering options for homes, parents, and safer browsing.

## Family Filtering
- [Families Overview](https://cloudflare-dns.com/family/): Introduces 1.1.1.1 for Families and available filtering modes.
- [DNS](https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns/): General resolver information relevant before enabling family filtering.
- [1.1.1.1 Home](https://cloudflare-dns.com/): Main product page for the broader 1.1.1.1 service.
